reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 18. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 2. Of 38 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 37 (97%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
Trump wants to put one of his lackeys in charge of Congress' watchdog over your taxpayer money.
 
This is just another way he's trying to prevent Congress from ensuring taxpayer money is being used appropriately so he can keep spending however he likes. https://t.co/WaE4wFqbR7

Read my full statement here: 
https://t.co/vTMG45E0VO

Putin's latest demands are a threat to the United States and our NATO allies.

The US cannot allow Russia to dictate NATO's future. https://t.co/xNos5V21XX

The historic results of the recent elections sent an unmistakable message: The American people want a Congress that is willing to act boldly to make life more affordable.

As the next chairman of @HouseBudgetDems, that’s exactly what I’m setting out to do. https://t.co/PbdrtuQnoL

Read my full statement here: 
https://t.co/fd1M790UqR

Lung cancer is a devastating disease that impacts hundreds of thousands of Americans and their families every year.

My bipartisan resolution calls for more research and awareness about this deadly disease: https://t.co/XSSjtgKGrb

While Trump jacks up prices with his tariffs and his forever wars, he's also taking food off the table for millions of Americans who need it most.

Trump's immoral administration is kicking them while they're already down. https://t.co/NvY6DAJzxx
https://t.co/9nwrU7a82w

Republicans made health care more expensive and more complicated for millions of Americans so billionaires could get massive tax breaks.

Working Americans will have a harder time getting by because of the choice Republicans made.

My first priority is to reverse these cuts. https://t.co/MPLVtDzTpb

We don't have to choose between bringing down costs and holding the Trump administration accountable.

Trump's corruption and disastrous policies have only made costs worse. These issues are connected.

Americans want action on both, and I'll fight like hell to get the job done. https://t.co/dWOVsHLKQh

The countless men and women in uniform who put our nation and its principles ahead of themselves are what make America exceptional.

On Veterans Day, and every day, I'm deeply grateful for the selflessness and sacrifice of all those who have served our nation. https://t.co/TsrFOK7oaF

Police have a tough job, and I'm doing what I can to make sure they have the tools they need to work with our communities and keep us safe.

I'm proud to have delivered this million-dollar investment to help build the safe neighborhoods we all deserve. https://t.co/PEy8XPy1Y8

Everyone knows Trump's economy doesn't put regular Americans first. 

That's why they sent a resounding message to finally bring down costs. Lowering the cost of living will be top priority for me as the next chairman of @housebudgetdems. https://t.co/gekGZWIDRB

Read my full statement here:

https://t.co/UKAoWwNrOh

I proudly delivered $1.04 million in funding to improve public safety at Temple University and in the surrounding community.

This money will help keep the brave men and women who serve as Temple police safe and strengthen their relationships with the communities they serve. https://t.co/meQi7oWvEc

Happy Diwali, Bandi Chhor Divas, Mahavir Nirvana Divas, and Kali Puja to everyone celebrating in Philadelphia and around the world!

Wishing our Hindu, Sikh, Jain, and all other neighbors observing these special occasions a joyous celebration filled with peace, happiness, and togetherness.

Every American has the right to peacefully protest policies of any government, and that includes Israel.

But targeting a business just because the owner is Jewish is wrong. It is antisemitism.

My statement on the planned boycott of Jewish-owned businesses in Philly: https://t.co/szhvz3sFCY

posts.text:
The American people have said overwhelmingly that it's time for change in Washington.

As the next chairman of @housebudgetdems, my priorities are clear:

Restore health care, bring costs down, and end the forever wars. https://t.co/f4MoYjTB6z

Today is Election Day, Pennsylvania! 

Need help finding a polling place or making a plan to vote? Follow this link to learn more:

https://t.co/z3tMIRVTeC https://t.co/nCq9Ayak1H

The economy isn’t working for American families.

And everyone knows the man sitting in the Oval Office is to blame.

While Trump gave tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations, he raised prices for everyone else with his tariff taxes and his disastrous Iran war. https://t.co/hHH0uLV0bw

Team Boyle met with friends and neighbors at the Heitzman Recreation Center.

We're always here if you have thoughts or need help with a federal agency.

Visit my website to learn more about our services: https://t.co/KAiOWGiU7R https://t.co/X01Qrn7frw

This do-nothing president and Republicans in Congress had two years to lower costs for Americans.

So far, they’ve raised costs by cutting your health care, imposing new tariff taxes, and starting another forever war.

Americans know Trump’s agenda has ruined our economy. https://t.co/F6zVmCrZyU

President Trump said he doesn't "give a damn" about Americans struggling to afford gas.

Yeah, we can tell.

Americans have had enough of his failed policies that enrich billionaires while the rest of us are crushed by rising costs and another forever war. https://t.co/HP3JwNLsOH
The only myth is that President Trump would bring down costs “on day one.” https://t.co/rNpjhgoYa6

It's no secret that Washington has to get the national debt under control. 

But Republicans don't like to talk about how they wasted trillions of dollars on tax breaks for billionaires.

It's time to make them pay their fair share so we can fix our debt. https://t.co/JmsjG1rWCF
Learn more here: https://t.co/SZc6bh0jWA

It was an honor to join Feliz Filadelfia as they celebrate the improvements to Hammond Fields.

I’m proud to have secured $500,000 in federal funding to help ensure kids in Olney and the surrounding neighborhoods have a safe place to get outside and learn important lessons. https://t.co/Q445icaggP

Glad to hear Officer Rodriguez has been released from the hospital after the ambush that took Sgt. Shane Seiber’s life.

We owe an incredible debt to the officers who risk their lives to keep us safe.

I will continue praying for Officer Rodriguez and for Sgt. Seiber’s family. https://t.co/z6IONLNBHA

Do you know why you don't hear Republicans talk about their "Big Beautiful Bill" anymore?

Because they know they betrayed working people.

Reversing Trump's disastrous health care cuts must be Congress's top priority so we can bring down costs for American families. https://t.co/xzOYtqSKKV

Instead of lowering costs, Trump cut health care, gave tax breaks to billionaires, and started another forever war.

It’s no wonder the American people are feeling terrible about this economy — and they are right. https://t.co/HDtCRDJYaK

Donald Trump has chosen to betray Ukraine in exchange for flattery from Putin.

Trump's weakness is a threat to our safety at home and to our allies in Europe.

I stand with Ukraine, and I won't stop working to give the Ukrainian people the support they need to defend themselves. https://t.co/uJPA0mDy0e

Americans have been loud and clear that they want affordable health care and lower costs.

Instead of listening, Republicans in Washington cut Americans' health care so they could give billionaires massive tax breaks. https://t.co/c74T4jgxlu

Trump's corruption and his cost-of-living crisis are out of control.

His Republican enablers in Washington have looked the other way — I won't.

I will do everything in my power with @housebudgetdems to make Trump's administration answer for it all. https://t.co/putsVq4cdJ

Last year, Trump and Republicans cut health care for millions of Americans and raised premiums for millions more, just so billionaires could get even more tax breaks.

I'll fight like hell to reverse these cruel cuts. https://t.co/thXsN6dIUt

Visit my website to learn more about our services:

https://t.co/LMdMEo8Dct

Team Boyle met with friends and neighbors at the Philadelphia Protestant Home's senior fair in Northeast Philly.

It's always great to hear from constituents. If you have thoughts or need help with a federal agency, we are here to serve. https://t.co/RfZ87VfYz8

Trump promised Americans a "golden age."

It's a golden age for his billionaire donors — but everyone else is paying more and getting less.

He's cutting your health care, raising your taxes with his tariffs, and stealing from the poor to fund tax breaks for billionaires. https://t.co/EH1NSvvUkP
It turns out the economic policies from a president who managed to bankrupt a casino are a disaster for our economy. https://t.co/3gDSr1x42q

Trump has been in office for nearly two years, and all he has to show for it is broken promises.

Americans are fed up with his disastrous policies, which have made basic necessities more expensive. https://t.co/IQQQCJPBxp

The President seems to think that your tax dollars are just a slush fund he can use on his personal vanity projects.

You don't need to be a legal scholar to understand this is plain wrong.

I applaud this decision, which puts an end to some of Trump's obvious abuse. https://t.co/irW1I0t6P7

Heartbroken by reports of a horrific mass shooting in Erie, Pennsylvania this morning.

My prayers are with the community and families as they recover from this tragedy. https://t.co/1916kZAzHL

Devastated by the shooting of two Philly police officers and news that one of them has died. 

Our police officers risk their lives every day to ensure that our city is safer. We owe them and their families unending gratitude.

My prayers are with them and their families. https://t.co/EZOXX6jdOI

Donald Trump’s war in Iran has sent prices skyrocketing.

Trump could lower costs today by ending this reckless war. Instead, he’s aiding Russia and betraying Ukraine in a desperate attempt to temporarily bring prices down. https://t.co/DZH3cZC2Lp

Republicans are unbelievable hypocrites on the national debt.

They cut revenue by trillions so billionaires can get massive tax breaks.

Any serious plan to address the debt has to include reversing these shortfalls.

https://t.co/D9r5EwWhrh https://t.co/iQG5tOOOHD

We should take the debt seriously, but that means being honest about how we got here.  

Spending alone didn't get us to $40 trillion.  

Decades of tax breaks for billionaires and big corporations have cost taxpayers trillions.  

Read my full op-ed in @FT: https://t.co/QRcdafZBZt

We should take the debt seriously, but that means being honest about how we got here.

Spending alone didn't get us to $40 trillion.

Decades of tax breaks for billionaires and big corporations have cost taxpayers trillions.

Read my full op-ed in @FT: https://t.co/FQaWsEgX7k

Trump withdrew funding for life-saving health research, including programs at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia and the University of Pennsylvania.

Not only is this illegal, but it's immoral.

My Congressional Power of the Purse Act would stop this callous power grab. https://t.co/GKAOhYQISN

Trump isn't fooling anyone with his new $5,000 check stunt.

I haven't seen a dime from the DOGE or tariff checks he promised over a year ago.

In fact, he's done worse than give us nothing — he's costing Americans more with his tariff taxes and Iran war. https://t.co/fWGDeJlRf6

Everyone knows Trump's agenda has been a disaster for the economy. 

But we can start getting costs down in spite of him.

As the lead Democrat on @housebudgetdems, I'm committed to overturning his costly tariff taxes and stopping funding for his moronic war in Iran. https://t.co/NJNlo6lvEC

Regular Americans are working hard and getting less, as inflation eats away at their earnings.

This is a flashing red light for the health of our economy. https://t.co/l59uojkYtZ

President Trump doesn't have any excuse, and Americans are out of patience.

The reality is he's been a terrible president for the economy.

Americans deserve leaders in Washington who care about getting our economy back on track. https://t.co/cPVijM1Csb

Under Donald Trump, the dream of homeownership is becoming further out of reach for too many Americans.

I'm willing to work with anyone who's serious about lowering costs for families and getting our national debt under control. https://t.co/tKYqxp83TF

For the cost of his Iran war, Trump could have extended the enhanced Affordable Care Act tax credits and kept premiums down for millions of Americans.

But everyone knows he doesn't actually care about lowering costs.

This president only offers publicity stunts and forever wars. https://t.co/4mT2mxyDZu

Americans are sick and tired of President Trump subjecting them to his taxpayer-funded vanity projects.

Americans deserve a president who cares more about lowering their costs than promoting himself. https://t.co/wOZhDFt6LD

Trump is the most out-of-touch president in American history, and everyone knows it.

While his tariff taxes and his war in Iran keep your costs too high, he's spending your tax dollars on a gilded ballroom and tax breaks for billionaires. https://t.co/3GICoUMaPg

NEWS: The nonpartisan @USGAO just confirmed that Trump is breaking the law.

He isn't a king — he can't cancel programs created by law and spend your tax dollars on whatever he wants.

Congress must pass my Congressional Power of the Purse Act to stop his illegal power grabs. https://t.co/S8FwHJmYvZ

President Trump would have you think he's a king — that he can cancel federal programs established by law and instead spend your taxes on whatever he wants.

My Congressional Power of the Purse Act would stop Trump's power grabs and hold him accountable. https://t.co/F4SgCwI1gs

We haven't seen such low approval for a president on the economy since the Great Recession in 2008.

But it's not a mystery why — under Trump the cost of basic needs are rising out of control, and homeownership is out of reach for too many Americans. https://t.co/vJ661h5Fki

Read more about the Public Safety Wellness Tax Credit Act here: 

https://t.co/m8I1KRFKw2

The risks of a firefighter's job stay with them, even years after their career.

I'm announcing new legislation to help cover the costs of preventive health and wellness for firefighters and EMS departments.

They have our backs, and I'll always have theirs. https://t.co/flkvndfjIe

American families are paying so much more for basic essentials than when Trump took office.

Instead of helping, he has made things worse by waging war in Iran and imposing costly new tariffs.

He only has himself and his failed policies to blame. https://t.co/4WxPNABXFd

Late on a Friday night, Trump is attempting to illegally withhold funds that were already approved by Congress.

I won't stand by while he uses these back-door maneuvers to cut funding for American families.

Congress must pass my bill that would put an end to his power grabs. https://t.co/Bu56E9YCTB

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
